CFML Language Reference: Functions

YesNoFormat

Returns "Yes" for any value that counts as true and "No" for anything false. Numbers other than zero are true; so are the strings "Yes" and "True".

Category

Display and formatting functions

Syntax

YesNoFormat(value)

Parameters

value
A number, a boolean, or a string such as "yes", "no", "true" or "false". An empty string gives "No".

Returns

The string "Yes" or "No".

Usage

Handy for BIT columns and the results of decision functions, which otherwise print as 1/0 or YES/NO. A string that is not a boolean value, for example "maybe", causes an error.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFQUERY NAME="GetStaff" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets" MAXROWS="6">
SELECT FirstName, LastName, Contract FROM Employees ORDER BY LastName
</CFQUERY>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Employee</TH><TH>Contract (raw)</TH><TH>Contractor?</TH></TR>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="GetStaff">
<TR><TD>#FirstName# #LastName#</TD><TD>#Contract#</TD><TD>#YesNoFormat(Contract)#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>
<CFOUTPUT><P>Is 2000 a leap year? #YesNoFormat(IsLeapYear(2000))#</P></CFOUTPUT>
